cardio_train.csv.source: Public Kaggle-style cardiovascular survey CSV (exact Kaggle page/version not cited in repo — UNVERIFIED)
cardio_train.csv.identity_verification: Schema matches widely mirrored 'Cardiovascular Disease' tabular dataset (semicolon delimiter, age in days, binary cardio label). Official license file not found in repository.
cardio_train.csv.intended_task: Binary classification: presence/absence of cardiovascular disease

data_quality_audit.notes: Age is stored in days (consistent with public Kaggle cardiovascular survey schema). Blood pressure outliers are common in this dataset and require documented cleaning before modeling.

cardio_train.csv.notes: Label meaning is self-reported/annotated in the dataset, not clinically validated ground truth. Features include age, height, weight, blood pressure, cholesterol, glucose, smoking, alcohol, physical activity.
cardio_train.csv.identifier_type: id column present — sequential integer, not cryptographic or cross-linkable patient ID

patient_notes.csv.source: Kaggle — NBME Score Clinical Patient Notes Competition (2022)
patient_notes.csv.intended_task: Clinical concept / phrase identification from medical licensing examination notes
patient_notes.csv.notes: These are de-identified medical licensing exam notes, not real hospital patient records. The task is NLP — identifying specific clinical phrases, not diagnosing cardiovascular disease.

features.csv.source: Kaggle — NBME Score Clinical Patient Notes Competition (2022)
features.csv.intended_task: Lookup table: feature identifiers and their clinical concept descriptions
features.csv.notes: This is a reference/lookup file, not a training dataset. Maps feature_num to clinical concept phrases.

train.csv.source: Kaggle — NBME Score Clinical Patient Notes Competition (2022)
train.csv.intended_task: Supervised NLP: mapping (patient_note, feature) pairs to character-span annotations
train.csv.notes: Annotations are character-level spans identifying where a clinical concept appears in a patient note. Target is phrase location, NOT cardiovascular diagnosis label.

test.csv.source: Kaggle — NBME Score Clinical Patient Notes Competition (2022)
test.csv.notes: This is the Kaggle competition test file (withheld labels). Small file likely contains only IDs, not the full hidden test set.

sample_submission.csv.source: Kaggle — NBME Score Clinical Patient Notes Competition (2022)
sample_submission.csv.notes: Template file for Kaggle competition submissions. Contains no training labels.

paths_referenced_in_cells: Search common Kaggle locations for the PTB-XL raw-signal root (contains ptbxl_database.csv).
inspection.waveform_files_accessible: UNKNOWN — Notebook references waveform paths but these files are not in data/datasets/

preprocessing_for_12x1000_at_100hz.filename_lr: Already 12 leads × 1000 samples at 100 Hz — no resampling required.
preprocessing_for_12x1000_at_100hz.filename_hr: 500 Hz × 5000 samples — downsample by factor 5 (e.g. decimation or anti-alias filter) to 100 Hz × 1000.

labels_and_splits_summary.rhythm_column_documentation: scp_statements.csv rhythm=1.0 marks rhythm statements (e.g. SR, AFIB).
labels_and_splits_summary.sr_statement_meaning: SR = sinus rhythm (SCP-ECG); aECG REFID MDC_ECG_RHY_SINUS_RHY in official table.

official_multi_label_superclass.description: Five diagnostic superclasses NORM, MI, STTC, CD, HYP via scp_codes + scp_statements diagnostic_class.

medshield_sinus_rhythm_proxy.description: Repository contract: normal sinus rhythm (SNOMED 426783006) vs pathological superclasses MI/STTC. Operational mapping for audit counts: SR present in scp_codes AND no MI/STTC superclass vs MI or STTC superclass present. NOT validated heart-disease diagnosis.

recommended_strategy.primary: Patient-level split by patient_id with stratification on aggregated labels (deterministic seed 42).
recommended_strategy.official_baseline: strat_fold != 10 train/val, strat_fold == 10 test (matches example_physionet.py) — document patient leakage.
recommended_strategy.test_fold_for_model_selection: Forbidden — hold out fold 10 (or patient test partition) for final evaluation only.

target_definitions.notebook_primary_task: Multi-label diagnostic-superclass classification (NORM / MI / STTC / CD / HYP) with five independent binary sigmoid heads (BCEWithLogitsLoss).
target_definitions.repository_proxy_task_documentation: README.md and backend ModelVersion default target_definition describe a separate binary proxy: normal sinus rhythm (SNOMED 426783006) vs pathological superclasses (documented as MI, STTC). This SNOMED code was NOT found in ecg-ptb-xl.ipynb text.
